name: Double spark gap
summary: A spark gap form with two gaps sharing a common electrode, used to protect two conductors against a common earth.
description: The double spark gap places two gaps in one element, typically from each of two line conductors to a common centre electrode that is earthed. It protects a pair of conductors, such as a telecom pair, with a single component so that both lines are diverted together.

The symbol does not state breakdown voltages or whether both gaps are matched. If one gap breaks down before the other, a transverse voltage can appear across the protected pair. Check the product data where balanced breakdown matters.
readingNotes: Identify the common electrode connection to earth.
Check breakdown matching between the two gaps.
drawingChecklist: Show both line connections and the common earth.
distinction: A double spark gap protects two conductors to a common electrode; a single spark gap protects one path.
